keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: One seed keyword per line, up to 1,000 per run.

engines.title: Search engines
engines.description: Which search boxes to ask. Leave empty for all four.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr, es, ja.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP. Amazon suggestions come from that country's Amazon site (US, CA, MX, BR, GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, NL, IN, JP, AU); other countries use amazon.com.

expandAlphabet.title: A-Z expansion
expandAlphabet.description: Also ask for "keyword a", "keyword b" ... "keyword z". Finds many more long-tail suggestions (26 extra requests per keyword and engine).

expandQuestions.title: Question expansion (English)
expandQuestions.description: Also ask for "how keyword", "what keyword", "why keyword" and 9 more English question words.

expandPrepositions.title: Preposition expansion (English)
expandPrepositions.description: Also ask for "keyword for", "keyword with", "keyword vs" and 6 more English connecting words.

deduplicate.title: Remove duplicates
deduplicate.description: Save (and charge for) each suggestion once per engine, even if several expansions return it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The Actor normally works without a proxy.
